† [טָפַח] vb. extend, spread (Arabic طَفَحَ be full to overflowing, abound; Aramaic ܛܦܰܚ extend, spread; טְפוּחָא a step, foot-length; NH טֶפַח a span (cf. טֶפַח Infr.))—
Pi. Pf. טִפְּחָה Is 48:13; טִפַּחְתִּי La 2:22;— 1. spread out the heavens Is 48:13 (‖ יָֽסְדָה ארץ). 2. denom. from טֶפַח carry on the palms, dandle La 2:22 (‖ רִבִּיתִי I have brought up, reared).
